title: Integrated Graphics Warfare
body:
Integrated Graphics Warfare is a Linux‑friendly, client‑side optimization modpack built for players running Minecraft on integrated graphics and low‑power GPUs.

The pack focuses on improving FPS, frame pacing, memory usage, and chunk loading without changing gameplay, visuals, or requiring OptiFine. It avoids placebo mods, unnecessary configs, and aggressive tweaks, relying instead on proven performance improvements to keep the game smooth and playable.

Designed for Fabric/Quilt, this pack is low‑maintenance, easy to update, and ideal for players who want Minecraft to simply run better on weaker hardware—no FPS caps, no bloat, no nonsense.
